description: LOCKED single-shot baseline scores for the foresight meta-loop. Reference only — baseline does NOT participate in tournament judging. See program.md. Re-seeded 2026-04-16 with web tools enabled (temper_web_search, temper_web_fetch) to match the engine's probe tool set, so the comparison is fair.
locking_note: This file is tracked in git. verify_run.py checks that the synthesis file sha256 matches baseline_synthesis_sha256; any mismatch invalidates the run. Do not modify without also updating the sha.

rescoring_2026_04_16.reason: Original baseline was scored with a session that had no web access. After the engine's open-ended agents (orchestrator, probes, convergence-analyst, model-projector) got temper_web_search and temper_web_fetch, the comparison became asymmetric. Re-ran the baseline single-shot with the same model (anthropic / claude-sonnet-4-6) and tool access including web, same prompt template updated to explicitly direct web usage.
rescoring_2026_04_16.interpretation: Web tools produce a small but real uplift (+0.3 raw, +1 Borda). Gains on Specificity, Novelty, Plausibility, Grounding — exactly the axes web citations should improve. Losses on Completeness, Breadth, Falsifiability suggest the citation-heavy version traded coverage for depth. Net: narrow challenger win. Engine must beat this floor.
